raw_need: Migrate repository publication to AI Org Labs without legacy personal identity leakage.
validated_need: Publish a sanitized clean-history QIF repository under ai-org-labs/quality-intent-framework, removing legacy personal account identifiers from tracked files and avoiding legacy author metadata or tags in the new public history.
decision_summary: Clean-history migration is selected because preserving existing history would carry legacy author metadata; file-level replacement alone is insufficient for the privacy goal.

validation_questions_answered.question: Should old history be preserved?
validation_questions_answered.answer: No. History may be discarded, and clean history better satisfies the identity-removal goal.

validation_questions_answered.question: What must not change?
validation_questions_answered.answer: QIF v0.2.1 functional content, schemas, examples, verifier behavior, and AOF evidence should remain intact except for sanitized source references.

hidden_assumptions: Changing only tracked text would not remove author metadata from pushed history.
evidence_gaps: Push success depends on authenticated access to the new AI Org Labs repository.
